description: Generates a complete job resource with the RPScripts Jobs Creator for QBCore, Qbox or ESX: job definition and grades with salaries and boss flags, duty, stash, garage, armory, shop, crafting, harvest/process/sell, boss office, wardrobe, teleports, billing, dispatch, player and vehicle actions, plus the framework install entries (shared jobs entry or ESX SQL) and a README. Start from a template (preset) and/or pass a full spec. The output is checked statically with RPScripts Lab before it is returned. Templates: police, sheriff, ambulance, fire, security, mechanic, cardealer, taxi, delivery, trucking, business, restaurant, fishing, mining, gang.

name.description: Job id (overrides the template's), e.g. police

spec.description: A full Jobs Creator spec; replaces the template. Its shape is rpcrate.job.json from any create_job result: generate a preset, edit that file, pass it here.

name: create_job
title: Create a FiveM job (Jobs Creator)
